textos.Vários comentam que o personagem princip: Several comment that the main character is a cowardly and immature man who resorts to magical means to win a woman's love instead of facing his insecurities, and is the target of harsh criticism.
textos.Alguns mencionam que as brigas e discuss: Some mention that the fights and arguments are excessively loud and repetitive, making the experience tiring and hurting the development of the characters.
textos.Há quem diga que as expectativas criadas: Some say that the expectations created by the buzz were too high, and that the film, although good, cannot live up to all that fuss.

textos.A performance de Inde Navarrette foi amp: Inde Navarrette's performance was widely praised, with the actress masterfully conveying the character's two distinct personalities, alternating between vulnerability and coldness in a frighteningly convincing way.
textos.Muitas reviews apontaram o protagonista: Many reviews pointed to the male protagonist as the true obsessive of the plot, criticizing his selfish and manipulative attitudes, which end up destroying the life of the female character and of others around her.
textos.O filme foi elogiado por construir uma a: The film was praised for building an atmosphere of constant tension and discomfort, using more suggestion and suspense than cheap scares, which makes it a disturbing and innovative experience in the genre.
textos.A direção de fotografia foi destacada pe: The cinematography was highlighted for its creative use of light and shadow, unusual framing and changes of aspect ratio, which contribute to the dark mood and the sense of claustrophobia.
textos.Os elogios incluem a abordagem inovadora: The praise includes the innovative approach to the genre, which avoids possession clichés and presents a social critique disguised as horror, something rare and welcome in current cinema.
textos.As reviews mencionam como o filme explor: The reviews mention how the film explores themes of obsessive love and control, portraying in a raw way how selfish desires can destroy autonomy and lead to tragedy.

textos.Dirigido por Curry Barker e lançado em 2: Directed by Curry Barker and released in 2025, the horror and thriller feature Obsession tells the story of an incurable romantic who, without any grand intentions, acquires a mysterious toy that promises to grant one-of-a-kind wishes. However, by breaking the artifact while making the wish to win over his crush, he gets exactly what he wanted, only to discover that the result brings sinister consequences.

textos.Por fim, para quem se situa numa fração: Finally, for those in an even smaller fraction of the ratings (~3%), a significant share considers the script excessively predictable and full of the usual clichés.
